title: How my life has changed after becoming a non citizen National.
summary: Self-declared non-citizen national describes living 'private', using fictitious ID addresses and avoiding contracts with the state.

assertions.quote: i take you out of uh territorial jurisdiction from the state
what i mean private you are separating yourself from the strongman
the only way to retrieve rights is to discontinue all contracts
if you want to acquire a house using the 1099a you can have it

verdicts.note: A prisoner sent 1099-OID and related forms claiming up to $324 million; none of the recipients paid anything, his refund suit was dismissed and his claims were held frivolous. This is one case.
Form 1099-OID only reports interest income; it is not a financial instrument or a way to withdraw money from the Treasury, and the 8th Circuit upheld convictions for 1099-OID refund schemes.
A footnote describes a 1099-OID filing as an attempt to trigger 'spurious' tax refunds, rejected in the US Court of Federal Claims and on appeal.
